Khaata is built to keep your financial data on your phone.
What is stored on this device
Your accounts, transactions, budgets, goals and settings. All of it in the app\'s private storage, which other apps cannot read.
What is processed on your phone
Every calculation, every insight, category suggestions, natural-language entry and bank SMS parsing. None of it needs an internet connection.
Ad requests, if you are on the free plan. These do not include your financial data.
Purchase checks with Google Play, if you subscribe.

Your transaction amounts, merchants, balances, account numbers and bank messages. These are never sent to us or to anyone else.

Parsed on your phone, never uploaded. Off by default.
Khaata has no accounts and no sign-in. There is no server holding your data.
